preconditions.description: The number of songs is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the initial song is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The length of the string t is equal to n.
The index of the song is between 0 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All strings consist only of lowercase English letters.
preconditions.description: All input strings contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: The sum of lengths of sailors' names does not exceed 10^6.
preconditions.description: The total length of all sailor names does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: Output q lines, each containing the remainder modulo 10^9+7 of the number of occurrences of w in s_k.
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is the number of times the sailor's name appears in the specified song, modulo 10^9+7.
